body:
INSTAGRAM
Meeting ends. Tasks are already assigned.

Everyone agrees on actions, nobody writes them down, and next week it's the same meeting. So I let a workflow do it:
1. Transcript lands from your meeting recorder
2. AI pulls out owner, task, due date (and ignores "we should probably…")
3. Tasks get created in Notion, Asana or Linear
4. A summary goes to the team channel

n8n: https://n8n.io
Notion: https://notion.so
Asana: https://asana.com
Linear: https://linear.app

Got a boring task? Comment it below and I might automate it in the next episode.
Small business? DM me AUDIT.

TIKTOK
Meeting ends. Tasks are already assigned. Got a boring task? Comment it and I might automate it next.
